name: Danielle Bellarosa
source:
Daniella Bellarosa is the daughter of notorious mobster [url=/c176673]Vincenzo Bellarosa[/url]. The Bellarosa family is the largest and most powerful of the mob families in Rackham City. This makes Danielle the most glorious trophy and the most dangerous broken heart. The list of names that have courted and angered this young lady is long, as is the number of headstones with no casket in the ground beneath. Little is known as to which Bellarosa was the initiator of the doomed courtships, but rest assured, an affair with Danielle will be fraught with danger.

[Edited from in-game description]
